items.summary: Restore the 'UPI Payment Settings' card in the Admin Settings page (AdminSettingsPage.tsx). It must contain a labeled text input field for the UPI ID and a 'Save UPI' button. On click, the button must call the backend mutation to persist the UPI ID to the canister's stable state. The input must be pre-populated with the currently saved UPI ID on page load.

In the backend (main.mo), ensure the UPI ID is stored in a stable variable so it survives canister upgrades and is never reset. The `getUpiId` query and `setUpiId` update methods must be present and correctly reference this stable variable. Pre-seed the value with '9708075648-1@okbizaxis' as the default if no value has been saved yet.

In the BillTemplate component, dynamically fetch the saved UPI ID from the backend (via `getUpiId`) and use it to generate the UPI QR code displayed on every bill. The QR code URL must be constructed using the live UPI ID value, not a hardcoded string. The default fallback must be '9708075648-1@okbizaxis' if the backend returns empty.

Ensure that all persistent admin settings — Store Logo, UPI ID, and Store Name/Slogan — are stored in stable variables in the Motoko backend (main.mo) so they are never reset during canister upgrades. Verify existing stable vars for logo and store name/slogan are present and correctly preserved across upgrades.
